segments.text: If your concept research strategy involves looking at ads that are the longest running, in the next few minutes, I'm going to explain to you why that is the worst thing that you can do. There's actually two reasons why. When you're looking at ads that are the longest running,

Typically, it means that they are actually bottom of the funnel ads. Because if an ad can run for a long time, it means that it's converting an audience that's already coming from a top of funnel type of ad. Now, these ads could have high ROAS and everything, but they are very reliant on a top of funnel ad that has probably been scaled to actually bring the traffic for this ad. So essentially, you have an ad that's feeding this ad all the time, which allows it to run for a long time.

And so if you're just copying these ads by going on Atrio or AdSpy and sorting by longest running, you really are just generating a bunch of bottom of funnel type of creative.
